seo.description: Use PureGamma on your phone: scan to access remotely, or bind your iPhone over iMessage.

title: Mobile Access
subtitle: Use PureGamma on the go: scan to open it remotely, or bind your iPhone over iMessage for replies and daily briefs.

remote.title: Remote control
remote.subtitle: Scan the QR and enter the 8-digit PIN to use the full PureGamma on your phone (Agent, market wire, portfolio). Public access runs over a cloudflared tunnel — the server address is never exposed.
remote.restartNotice: After the relay restarts, phones must re-enter the PIN. Never share the tunnel URL or QR outside your team.
remote.userNote: Scan with your phone and enter the PIN to use PureGamma anywhere. The tunnel and PIN are managed by the platform operator.

imessage.title: iMessage
imessage.subtitle: Bind your iPhone over iMessage: get Agent replies and the daily brief right in Messages.
imessage.planRequired: iMessage requires a Max plan or above.
